command_or_source: Manual GUI and physical trackpad verification on app commit a61093e3fdde8445ce98094398c39f4d2780736b.
result_summary: The newly built status-bar app was launched and remained running, but menu navigation, shortcut recording, checked icons, restart restoration and physical three/four/five-finger triggering were not completed in the automated run.
limitations: The computer-use interface could not obtain an accessibility tree for this LSUIElement-only status-bar app.
Physical multi-finger contact cannot be generated by the automated pointer interface.
macOS native three/four/five-finger gestures may run alongside configured shortcuts; this implementation listens passively and does not suppress system gestures.
